rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 5 and 6 (ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-008, -p1-011): the prototype wins by default and only a DR1 judgement on the same difference or a real constraint the prototype cannot express overrides it; DR1's sort rows (inc-023, inc-024, inc-031) judge the dashboard's sort, not the templates list, the templates list is new so no real service behaviour clashes, and no persistence, validation, authentication or cross-service constraint is involved, so the prototype source (ranked above the trace) settles it.
outcome: Build Manage templates' 'Sort by:' select as Design Release 2.1 has it: named sort, options 'Select one' (empty value), 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', preselecting the option that matches the sort value in the address, outside any form and with no apply button. As in the prototype, the select does not reorder the list, so 'Arrival date' needs no meaning for templates; making the sort work would depart from the prototype with neither a DR1 judgement on this list nor a real constraint to justify it.
